provider: 联通云盘 / 沃盘 WoPan (pan.wo.cn, China Unicom)

free_tier.stated: 60 GB free. Raised from 10 GB by a 2025-09-01→15 promotion that was made permanent ('免费用户存储空间 由10GB 提升至60GB，空间长期有效'). Site tagline '不限速'. Non-Unicom numbers can register ('非联通用户也能注册').
free_tier.notes: Headline offer; binding constraint specified in limits.

per_object_cap.stated: No per-object cap documented in published terms; absence is not an unlimited claim.
per_object_cap.notes: extraction found no per-object clause; some of these providers meter on object count rather than bytes, and some state no cap

retention.stated: 60 GB free. Raised from 10 GB by a 2025-09-01→15 promotion that was made permanent ('免费用户存储空间 由10GB 提升至60GB，空间长期有效').

egress.terms: Advertised '不限速' on the homepage; no per-GB egress pricing found. Paid tiers step 6 TB.

tooling: OpenList driver `wopan` (has its own SDK: github.com/OpenListTeam/wopan-sdk-go, refresh-token + family-id support). Maintained, not reverse-engineered, which is unusual for a Chinese carrier drive.
chaining: 60 GB per account, phone-bound; each additional carrier number is a new identity. Carrier-family sharing ('family_id') pools within a household. Not a 500 GB play unless multiplied.
limits_note: Account quota of 60 GB is the primary constraint. No per-file size cap is published in official documentation.
reliability_note: Quota is promotional and has already changed once; operator drives historically shrink free tiers after the growth phase.
